intro.speaker: FOREMAN NIX
intro.text: Two branch lines are converging at the Railway Hub. Ensure all feature commits merge through automated tests before packaging.

success.speaker: FOREMAN NIX
success.text: Continuous Integration stabilized! Multiple branches now merge and test automatically on every commit.

failure.speaker: FOREMAN NIX
failure.text: An isolated branch bypassed the integration test suite. Merge and test before release.

targetMisconception: Merge at the end is fine.

nodes.description: The trunk repository branch containing production-ready code.
An active feature branch with pending developer changes.
Integrates branch code and verifies merge conflicts automatically.
Runs integration and regression tests on the merged code.
Packages tested artifacts for production rollout.
Dispatches validated releases into live production traffic.

rules: Both branches must integrate through MERGE_GATE
win: All branch changes integrate through one tested path
fail: A branch bypasses the test gate

engineerMode.whatYouDid: You built an automated integration pipeline that merges and tests multiple branches continuously.
keyTakeaways: Continuous Integration (CI) prevents merge hell by testing every branch upon commit.
Never allow unmerged feature branches to bypass verification gates directly into production.
engineerMode.artifact:
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  merge_and_test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm test
      - run: npm run build

annotation.text: Every pull request triggers continuous integration against the main branch.
Automated test suites gate packaging and deployment.
